purpose: Predict task-level output error from frozen ISA circuits and calibration; assess histogram utility and prediction mismatch.

execution.compiler_configuration: Resolve once before pilot; preserve and validate exposure treatments
execution.runtime_options: Resolve and save effective options; prediction must describe executed transformations

families.reference: Point mass at bv.expected_outcomes[0], the reversed secret_string
families.construction: Use QWARD BernsteinVazirani; L=0 unchanged; for L>0 insert barrier-protected U_L,inverse(U_L) on data after oracle and before final data H.
families.padding_sequence: Shared across patterns; prefix of the same sequence across L

families.construction: H(q0); chain CX; RZ(phi,q0); for X measurement add H on all outputs; measure

families.reference: cos(theta/2)^2 at t=bv.expected_outcomes[0]; sin(theta/2)^2 at t with rightmost bit toggled
families.construction: Unpadded QWARD ALT BV; insert RY(theta,q0) after final data H and before measurement

budget.smoke_test_filter: Core families only; output width 2; one layout; one window

analysis.test_multiplicity: Bonferroni over the prespecified claims in each fixed analysis family
analysis.interval_multiplicity: Prespecified simultaneous intervals for joint decisions; marginal intervals labeled separately
analysis.primary_evaluation_population: BV sweep only; controls reported separately
analysis.generalization: Validate on independent calibration windows before automatic triage

screening.primary_criterion: Statistical resolution in units of uncertainty
screening.combined_uncertainty: Requires calibrated prediction/model uncertainty and dependence treatment; otherwise label shot-only residual
screening.target_signal: Prespecified BV target versus frozen background; uniform is an explicit hypothesis
screening.decision_test: Exact one-sided binomial tail with campaign multiplicity adjustment
screening.unresolved_signal: Inconclusive at current shots; optional deprioritization for answer interpretation, not proof of no information
screening.implementation_status: Conditional exact binomial count budgets, signed predicted-shot residuals and uniform-target diagnostics implemented; model uncertainty calibration pending
screening.derived_baseline_multiplicity: 0.05/(5 * completed primary runs) for two central ranges, two upper budgets and one target-background claim; retrospective fixed-archive analysis

selection_rationale: User reports BV gave the best results in earlier experimentation; test prospective reliability under controlled noise exposure.

qward_integration.treatment_adapter: Copy library circuit; insert identity padding after oracle and before final H; insert RY fault after final H and before measurement
qward_integration.submission_change_required: Accept frozen ISA circuit paired with saved prediction

implementation.multiplicity: conservative Bonferroni over five claim families and planned executions per window for new preparations; preserve archived allocation

simulator_baseline.noise_models: Synthetic Target average gate infidelities -> Aer local depolarization; symmetric readout; no thermal/idle channel
